where: landing headline, live preview, logging workspace
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; change the portion multiplier, assert totals and range state, log it, then confirm the base amount remains 60 g

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for its service worker, set the context offline, reload, and assert sample data

claim: Meal records stay in this browser.
sandbox: record every request during a complete demo log and assert all requests are same-origin

claim: Exports meal logs as CSV and all records as JSON.
sandbox: demo data; download both formats and assert the CSV header and JSON templates and logs

claim: Demo changes never enter real records, and Reset demo restores the sample.
sandbox: fresh browser context; log in /demo, open /app and assert empty state, then reset the demo and assert its original log count

claim: The one-click sample opens two editable meals and one earlier log without saving to personal records.
where: landing first-screen action, README, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert the persistent demo banner, both named sample meals, one earlier log, and Reset demo restoring that log

claim: The complete product is free to use.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert the full log and export actions are available with no payment, purchase, or upgrade action

claim: Invalid JSON backups are rejected without changing saved records.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; save a meal, import the verifier's malformed fixture, compare IndexedDB before and after, reload, and assert the meal still renders without page errors

claim: Create a meal template with custom nutrition ranges, then use those ranges when logging.
where: landing how-it-works section, meal-template form, README
sandbox: fresh browser context entered through /?demo=1; leave the demo, create a real meal template with non-default calorie and macro ranges, reload it, confirm every range, then log against those ranges

claim: A JSON backup restores every exported meal template and log.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; export the complete sample, erase the demo workspace, import that exact file, and compare every restored template and log with the export

claim: Erasing records asks for confirmation before clearing the active browser workspace.
where: landing privacy section, data controls, README
sandbox: fresh demo; dismiss the erase confirmation and assert the named sample meal remains visible
